SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, stu.user_id AS userId, stu.student_number AS studentId, usr.real_name AS studentName, IFNULL(stu.admin_class, '') AS className, c.course_name AS courseName, COUNT(ar.record_id) AS absenceCount, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(sess.start_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastAbsenceTime, DATE_FORMAT(notice_stat.lastNotifyTime, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastNotifyTime, IFNULL(notice_stat.notifyCount, 0) AS notifyCount, CASE WHEN IFNULL(notice_stat.unreadCount, 0) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS hasUnread FROM attendance_record ar INNER JOIN attendance_session sess ON ar.session_id = sess.session_id INNER JOIN course c ON sess.course_id = c.course_id INNER JOIN student stu ON ar.student_id = stu.user_id INNER JOIN user usr ON stu.user_id = usr.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT teacher_id, student_id, course_id, COUNT(*) AS notifyCount, MAX(send_time) AS lastNotifyTime, SUM(CASE WHEN read_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unreadCount FROM attendance_notice WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND send_status = 1 GROUP BY teacher_id, student_id, course_id ) notice_stat ON notice_stat.teacher_id = c.teacher_id AND notice_stat.student_id = ar.student_id AND notice_stat.course_id = c.course_id
GROUP BY c.course_id, stu.user_id, stu.student_number, usr.real_name, stu.admin_class, c.course_name, notice_stat.lastNotifyTime, notice_stat.notifyCount, notice_stat.unreadCount ORDER BY COUNT(ar.record_id) DESC, MAX(sess.start_time) DESC, c.course_id DESC, stu.student_number

SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, stu.user_id AS userId, stu.student_number AS studentId, usr.real_name AS studentName, IFNULL(stu.admin_class, '') AS className, c.course_name AS courseName, COUNT(ar.record_id) AS absenceCount, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(sess.start_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastAbsenceTime, DATE_FORMAT(notice_stat.lastNotifyTime, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastNotifyTime, IFNULL(notice_stat.notifyCount, 0) AS notifyCount, CASE WHEN IFNULL(notice_stat.unreadCount, 0) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS hasUnread FROM attendance_record ar INNER JOIN attendance_session sess ON ar.session_id = sess.session_id INNER JOIN course c ON sess.course_id = c.course_id INNER JOIN student stu ON ar.student_id = stu.user_id INNER JOIN user usr ON stu.user_id = usr.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT teacher_id, student_id, course_id, COUNT(*) AS notifyCount, MAX(send_time) AS lastNotifyTime, SUM(CASE WHEN read_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unreadCount FROM attendance_notice WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND send_status = 1 GROUP BY teacher_id, student_id, course_id ) notice_stat ON notice_stat.teacher_id = c.teacher_id AND notice_stat.student_id = ar.student_id AND notice_stat.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND c.course_id = #{courseId} AND ar.student_id = #{studentId} AND ar.status = 0
AND sess.start_time >= CONCAT(#{query.startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND sess.start_time <= CONCAT(#{query.endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
GROUP BY c.course_id, stu.user_id, stu.student_number, usr.real_name, stu.admin_class, c.course_name, notice_stat.lastNotifyTime, notice_stat.notifyCount, notice_stat.unreadCount

SELECT ar.record_id AS id, DATE_FORMAT(sess.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS date, c.course_name AS course, ar.status AS status, CASE WHEN ar.status = 0 THEN '缺勤' WHEN ar.status = 1 THEN '已到' WHEN ar.status = 2 THEN '迟到' WHEN ar.status = 3 THEN '请假' ELSE '未知' END AS statusText, CASE WHEN ar.status = 0 THEN 'danger' WHEN ar.status = 1 THEN 'success' WHEN ar.status = 2 THEN 'warning' WHEN ar.status = 3 THEN 'info' ELSE 'info' END AS statusType FROM attendance_record ar INNER JOIN attendance_session sess ON ar.session_id = sess.session_id INNER JOIN course c ON sess.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND c.course_id = #{courseId} AND ar.student_id = #{studentId}
AND sess.start_time >= CONCAT(#{query.startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND sess.start_time <= CONCAT(#{query.endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
ORDER BY sess.start_time DESC, ar.record_id DESC

SELECT n.notice_id AS id, usr.real_name AS studentName, stu.student_number AS studentId, n.course_id AS courseId, IFNULL(c.course_name, '综合提醒') AS courseName, n.absent_count AS absenceSnapshot, n.title AS title, DATE_FORMAT(n.send_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS sentTime, CASE WHEN n.read_status = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isRead FROM attendance_notice n INNER JOIN student stu ON n.student_id = stu.user_id INNER JOIN user usr ON stu.user_id = usr.user_id LEFT JOIN course c ON n.course_id = c.course_id
ORDER BY n.send_time DESC, n.notice_id DESC
